distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 283.8401 +/- 0.0220 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 3.52 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.3561 +/- 0.0039 solar radii from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 725A: radius in solar radii, 0.3561 +/- 0.0039, from this work (CHARA) (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112): 247,739 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.318 solar masses from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 725A: mass 0.318 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3407 +/- 15 K from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 725A: effective temperature in K, 3407 +/- 15, from this work (CHARA) (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 725A: effective temperature in K, 3407 +/- 15, from this work (CHARA) (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112)
